items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: booking agent booked this Complicated Jazz Concert, and she was with us as the vocalist... I said, Dinah, come in now.

ctx.x: : But I mean that's a little like Sarah Vaughan, isn't it, because I mean she was a rough, tough girl. I mean she had to go with somebody like Hines to --
The toughest of all them was Dinah Washington.
